changelog:
- Initial release of multi-search-engine v2.0.1.
- Integrates 17 search engines: 8 domestic (China) and 9 international/global.
- Supports advanced search operators (site, filetype, quotes, exclude, OR) and time filters.
- Adds privacy-focused search engines (DuckDuckGo, Startpage, Brave, Qwant).
- Enables use of DuckDuckGo bangs and WolframAlpha knowledge queries.
- No API keys required for any engine.
